title: trigger
t

messages.description: any message to be sequenced over the outlets
sequenced messages from right to left

arguments.description: symbols that define outlet's message type. 'float', 'bang', 'symbol', 'list', 'anything', and 'pointer', all of which can be abbreviated

body: [trigger] sends its input to each of its outlets in right-to-left order, converting it as its arguments say: bang, float, symbol, list, anything, pointer, or a constant value.
